=== King Arthur & Merlin ===
:''Note: If you start the quest with the required/recommended weapons and armour, you will have to bank everything before travelling to Entrana.''
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[King Arthur]]. {{Chat option|1Tell me of this quest.|1I'd enjoy trying that.}}
*Talk to [[Merlin]]. {{Chat option|1Thank you for the advice.}}
**He will now be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, in the room with the cauldron. Go up the main staircase and head to the eastern room. He won't show up as a yellow dot on the minimap until you have entered the room.
}}
